	📋 How to Download SSC CGL Tier-I Exam City / Admit Card 2026 Out for 12256 Post

	
		Visit the official website ssc.gov.in or your concerned SSC Regional website.
		Click on the “Admit Card” tab and open the Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (Tier-I) City Intimation / Admit Card link.
		Log in with your Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password.
		Download the Exam City Intimation Slip first (about 10 days before exam) and later the Admit Card (2–3 days before exam).
		Print the Admit Card and carry it to the exam centre with a valid Photo ID and recent photographs.
	

	Note: City Intimation Slip only shows exam city. Full centre address, date and shift are on the Admit Card. Check details carefully and contact SSC helpline for any issue.

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.

																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension

																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)

																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.

																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance : Name of Post:

															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.

Compiler posts) Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts) Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 Click Here Top Online Form 2026 (All Current Job List) Click Here SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-   Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT) Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test) Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates) Sections: General Intelligence and Reasoning General Awareness Quantitative Aptitude English Comprehension Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section) Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer Syllabus for Tier-I: General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc. General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc. Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc. English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.   Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT) Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test) Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates) Papers: Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts) Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts) Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV) Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III. Syllabus for Tier-II: Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions. Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions. Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc. Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance

Compiler posts) Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts) Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 															SSC CGL 2026 Exam Pattern/ Syllabus:-

															 

															Tier-I: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																Duration: 60 minutes (80 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																Sections:
																
																	General Intelligence and Reasoning
																	General Awareness
																	Quantitative Aptitude
																	English Comprehension
																
																
																Total Marks: 200 (50 marks per section)
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer, -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer
															

															Syllabus for Tier-I:

															
																General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, spatial orientation, problem-solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, etc.
																General Awareness: Current affairs, history, culture, geography, economic scene, general policy and scientific research, etc.
																Quantitative Aptitude: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers, percentage, ratio and proportion, square roots, averages, interest, profit and loss, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistical charts, etc.
																English Comprehension: Reading comprehension, fill in the blanks, spelling, idioms and phrases, one-word substitution, sentence correction, error spotting, synonyms, antonyms, etc.
															

															 

															Tier-II: Computer Based Examination (CBT)

															
																
																Exam Mode: Online (Computer Based Test)
																
																
																Duration: 120 minutes per paper (160 minutes for visually handicapped candidates)
																
																
																Papers:

																
																	Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities
																	Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension
																	Paper-III: Statistics (only for Statistical Investigator Grade II & Compiler posts)
																	Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics) (only for Assistant Audit Officer/Assistant Accounts Officer posts)
																
																
																
																Total Marks: Varies (200 marks per paper for Paper I and II, 100 marks per paper for Paper III and IV)
																
																
																Marking Scheme: +2 marks for each correct answer in Paper I, II, and IV, +1 mark for each correct answer in Paper III. Negative marking of -0.5 marks for each incorrect answer in Paper I, II, and IV, and -0.25 marks for Paper III.
																
															

															Syllabus for Tier-II:

															
																Paper-I: Quantitative Abilities: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-II: English Language and Comprehension: Same as Tier-I but more advanced level questions.
																Paper-III: Statistics: Collection and representation of data, measure of dispersion, moments, skewness and kurtosis, correlation and regression, probability theory, sampling theory, etc.
																Paper-IV: General Studies (Finance and Economics): Finance Commission, Basic Concept of Economics and Introduction to Micro Economics, Theory of Demand and Supply, Theory of Production and Cost, Forms of Market and Price Determination in Different Markets, Indian Economy, Economic Reforms in India, Money and Banking, Role of IT in Governance
